name: Alexander
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure the Cognac, dark crème de cacao and cold cream into a shaker.
Shake with ice until the cream is fully mixed and the tin is cold.
Strain into the coupe.
Grate a little nutmeg over the surface if available.

name: Americano
steps: Fill a rocks glass with ice.
Pour the Campari and sweet vermouth over the cubes.
Add a splash of cold soda.
Lift the liquids together once with a bar spoon.
Squeeze lemon peel over the glass to release its oils.
Tuck a half-slice of orange beside the ice.
garnish: Half an orange slice and a strip of lemon zest.

name: Angel Face
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure the gin, apricot brandy and Calvados into a shaker.
Shake over ice until the tin feels thoroughly cold.
Strain into the chilled glass.

name: Aviation
steps: Measure the gin, maraschino, fresh lemon juice and crème de violette into a shaker.
Shake with ice until the tin frosts.
Fine-strain into a cold coupe.
Drop in a maraschino cherry if desired.

name: Bee’s Knees
steps: Stir the honey syrup into the lemon and orange juices in the shaker.
Pour in the dry gin.
Shake the mixture briskly over ice.
Strain into a cold coupe.
For a citrus aroma, squeeze a strip of lemon or orange peel over the drink.
garnish: Lemon or orange zest, if desired.

name: Bellini
steps: Chill a flute and the Prosecco.
Spoon the peach purée into a mixing glass with ice.
Pour in the Prosecco slowly.
Stir just enough to distribute the peach without flattening the bubbles.
Pour into the flute while holding back the mixing ice.

name: Between the Sheets
steps: Measure the white rum, Cognac, triple sec and lemon juice into a shaker.
Shake firmly with ice until the tin is cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Black Russian
steps: Set firm cubes in a rocks glass.
Pour the vodka and coffee liqueur over the cubes.
Stir until the dark liqueur is evenly mixed and the outside of the glass is cold.

name: Bloody Mary
steps: Measure the vodka, tomato juice, lemon juice and Worcestershire into a mixing glass.
Season to taste with Tabasco, celery salt and black pepper.
Stir gently over ice so the tomato juice stays smooth.
Strain into a rocks glass, or over fresh ice in a highball.
Add celery or a lemon wedge if desired.
serving_notes: For service over ice, use a highball glass.

name: Boulevardier
steps: Measure bourbon or rye into a mixing glass with Campari and sweet vermouth.
Stir over ice until the glass feels cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Squeeze a strip of orange or lemon peel over the drink.
garnish: Orange zest, with lemon zest as another option.

name: Bramble
steps: Pack a rocks glass with crushed ice.
Shake the gin, lemon juice and simple syrup over cubed ice.
Strain onto the crushed ice.
Drizzle crème de mûre over the top so it seeps through the ice.
Add a lemon slice and blackberries if desired.

name: Brandy Crusta
steps: Wet the rim of a narrow coupe with cut orange or lemon.
Dip the damp rim in fine sugar.
Curl a broad strip of citrus peel inside the glass.
Measure the brandy, maraschino, curaçao, lemon juice, syrup and bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until cold.
Strain into the prepared glass, keeping the sugar rim dry.
garnish: Sugar rim and a long orange or lemon peel.

name: Caipirinha
steps: Cut the lime into small wedges.
Put the wedges and cane sugar in a double rocks glass.
Press the wedges gently until the juice wets the sugar, taking care to leave the peel intact.
Add the cachaça and cracked ice.
Stir from the bottom to lift the lime and sugar.

name: Canchanchara
steps: Work the honey into the lime juice and water in a terracotta cup.
Fill the cup with cracked ice.
Pour in the aguardiente.
Stir from the bottom to lift the settled honey.
Finish with a lime wedge.

name: Cardinale
steps: Measure the gin, dry vermouth and Campari into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until the glass feels cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Pinch a strip of lemon zest over the surface.

name: Casino
steps: Measure Old Tom gin, maraschino, lemon juice and orange bitters into a shaker.
Shake with ice until cold.
Strain over new cubes in a chilled rocks glass.
Finish with lemon zest and a maraschino cherry.
garnish: Lemon zest and a maraschino cherry.

name: Champagne Cocktail
steps: Place a sugar cube in a chilled flute.
Saturate the cube with bitters.
Pour in the Cognac and Grand Marnier, if using it.
Add the cold Champagne slowly to give the foam room to settle.
Finish with orange zest and a maraschino cherry.

name: Chartreuse Swizzle
steps: Measure Green Chartreuse, falernum, pineapple juice and lime juice into a highball.
Half-fill the glass with pebble ice.
Roll a swizzle stick between your palms until the glass frosts. A long spoon also works.
Heap more pebble ice above the rim.
Finish with mint and a light grating of nutmeg.
garnish: Mint and a dusting of nutmeg.

name: Clover Club
steps: Measure the gin, raspberry syrup, lemon juice and egg white into a shaker.
Shake without ice to build foam.
Shake again with ice to chill.
Fine-strain into a cold coupe.
Place a few raspberries on the settled foam if available.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

name: Corpse Reviver #2
steps: Measure the gin, Cointreau, Lillet Blanc and lemon juice into a shaker.
Add the absinthe a dash at a time to control the pour.
Shake over ice until cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
Squeeze a piece of orange peel over the drink.

name: Cosmopolitan
steps: Measure the citron vodka, Cointreau, lime juice and cranberry juice into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
Twist lemon peel over the drink to release its oils.

name: Cuba Libre
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Pour in the white rum and lime juice.
Top with cold cola.
Lift gently with a bar spoon to preserve the fizz.
Add a lime wedge.

name: Daiquiri
steps: Stir superfine sugar into the lime juice and white Cuban rum in the shaker until the grains dissolve.
Shake hard with ice until the tin feels cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe to catch any ice chips.

name: Dark ‘N’ Stormy
steps: Fill a highball with ice cubes.
Add cold ginger beer, leaving space at the top.
Float Goslings rum over the ginger beer using the back of a spoon.
Add a slice or wedge of lime.

name: Don’s Special Daiquiri
steps: Measure both rums, passion fruit syrup, honey syrup and lime juice into a drink mixer.
Pulse briefly with crushed ice until cold and loose enough to pour.
Transfer to a footed copo glass.
Top up with more crushed ice.
Set half a passion fruit on top if available.

ingredients.note: Crushed ice, plus more for serving

name: Dry Martini
steps: Chill a martini glass.
Measure the gin and dry vermouth into a mixing glass.
Stir over ice until the mixture is thoroughly cold and lightly diluted.
Strain into the chilled martini glass.
Finish with lemon oils or a green olive.
garnish: Express lemon peel over the drink, or add green olives on request.

name: Espresso Martini
steps: Brew a strong shot of espresso.
Measure the espresso, vodka, Kahlúa and syrup into a shaker.
Shake vigorously over ice to build a cap of foam.
Fine-strain into a cold coupe.
Place coffee beans on the foam once it settles.

name: Fernandito
steps: Pack a double rocks glass with cubes.
Measure the Fernet-Branca over the ice.
Pour cold cola down the side of the glass, pausing if the foam rises.
Lift once with a bar spoon to bring the Fernet up from the bottom.

name: French 75
steps: Chill a flute and the Champagne.
Measure the gin, lemon juice and syrup into a shaker.
Shake the base over ice.
Strain into the flute, leaving room for the Champagne.
Pour in the measured Champagne.
Give the drink one gentle stir.

name: French Connection
steps: Set firm ice cubes in a rocks glass.
Measure the Cognac and amaretto over the ice.
Stir slowly until the glass feels cold.

name: French Martini
steps: Measure the vodka, raspberry liqueur and pineapple juice into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice to aerate the juice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Squeeze a strip of lemon peel over the foam.
garnish: Express lemon peel over the surface.

name: Garibaldi
steps: Prepare fresh orange juice or use bottled orange juice.
Whisk the juice briefly if you want a frothy top.
Load a highball with cubes.
Pour Campari over the ice.
Add the orange juice.
Lift once with a spoon to mix.
Tuck an orange wedge at the top.

name: Gin Basil Smash
steps: Rinse the basil leaves.
Add them to a shaker with gin, lemon juice and syrup.
Shake sharply with ice to bruise the leaves and release their aroma.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe to catch fragments of basil.

name: Gin Fizz
steps: Chill a narrow highball.
Measure the gin, lemon juice and syrup into a shaker.
Shake the base over ice.
Strain into the empty cold glass.
Add a splash of cold soda.
Finish with a lemon slice.
garnish: Lemon slice, plus zest if desired.

name: Grand Margarita
steps: Moisten the rim of a rocks glass with cut lime.
Dip the damp edge in sea salt.
Put fresh ice in the glass.
Measure the tequila, Grand Marnier and lime juice into a shaker.
Shake firmly with separate ice.
Strain into the rimmed glass without pouring over the salt.
Add a lime slice.
garnish: Lime slice and a sea-salt rim.

name: Grasshopper
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure the white crème de cacao, green crème de menthe and cold cream into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice until the cream is fully incorporated.
Strain into the coupe.
Add a mint leaf if desired.

name: Hanky Panky
steps: Measure the London dry gin, sweet vermouth and Fernet into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice to chill the mixture thoroughly.
Strain into a cold coupe.
Twist orange peel over the finished drink.

name: Hemingway Special
steps: Measure the rum, grapefruit juice, maraschino and lime juice into a shaker.
Shake with ice until the mixture is very cold.
Fine-strain into a large chilled coupe.

name: Horse’s Neck
steps: Cut a long spiral of lemon peel.
Wind the peel around the inside of a highball.
Use ice cubes to hold the peel in place.
Pour in the Cognac and ginger ale.
Add a dash of bitters if desired.
Stir lightly to preserve the bubbles.
garnish: A long spiral of lemon peel.

name: Havana Tiki
steps: Press a thin slice of fresh ginger into the bottom of a shaker with a muddler.
Add both rums, amaretto, Frangelico, maraschino, passion fruit purée and the two juices.
Shake firmly with ice.
Strain into a tiki mug over pebble ice.
Top up with more pebble ice.
Finish with citrus and dried pineapple if available.
garnish: Citrus and a dehydrated pineapple slice.

name: Illegal
steps: Measure the mezcal, overproof white rum, falernum, maraschino, lime juice and syrup into a shaker.
If using egg white, add it to the shaker.
If you added egg white, shake without ice to build foam.
Shake hard with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe, or over ice in a terracotta cup.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

serving_notes: For service over ice, use a clay or terracotta mug.

name: Irish Coffee
steps: Warm an Irish coffee glass with hot water.
Tip out the warming water.
Measure the hot coffee, whiskey and sugar into the glass.
Stir until the sugar dissolves.
Whisk the cold cream lightly until thickened but still pourable.
Float the cream over the back of a spoon.

name: John Collins
steps: Load a highball with ice.
Add the gin, lemon juice and simple syrup.
Top with cold soda.
Stir slowly from the bottom to disperse the syrup.
Finish with a slice of lemon and a maraschino cherry.

name: Jungle Bird
steps: Measure blackstrap rum, Campari, pineapple juice, lime juice and Demerara syrup into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice.
Strain over fresh cubes in a rocks glass.
Set a pineapple wedge against the ice.

name: Kir
steps: Chill a wine glass and the dry white wine.
Measure the crème de cassis into the glass.
Pour the wine over the liqueur.
Swirl the glass gently if the color is uneven.

name: Last Word
steps: Measure the gin, Green Chartreuse, maraschino and fresh lime juice into a shaker.
Shake briskly with ice until the tin frosts.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Lemon Drop Martini
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure the vodka, triple sec and lemon juice into a shaker.
Shake firmly with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into the coupe.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure in the vodka, tequila, white rum, gin and Cointreau.
Add the lemon juice and syrup.
Fill the remaining space with cold cola.
Give the drink one gentle stir.
Garnish with a lemon slice if desired.

name: Mai Tai
steps: Measure both rums, curaçao, orgeat, lime juice and syrup into a shaker.
Shake with ice until cold.
Strain over crushed ice in a double rocks glass.
Finish with mint, pineapple and lime peel if available.
garnish: Pineapple spear, mint, and lime peel.
serving_notes: A highball glass is another option.

name: Manhattan
steps: Measure rye, sweet vermouth and bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until cold and lightly diluted.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Drop in a cocktail cherry.

name: Margarita
steps: For a salt rim, wet half the lip of the coupe with lime.
If salting the glass, dip the damp side lightly in salt.
Measure the tequila, triple sec and lime juice into a shaker.
Shake firmly with ice.
Strain into the chilled coupe, keeping the liquid away from the salted lip.

name: Martinez
steps: Measure the London dry gin, sweet vermouth, maraschino and orange bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir over ice until the glass feels cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Squeeze lemon peel over the drink.

name: Mary Pickford
steps: Measure the white rum, pineapple juice, maraschino and grenadine into a shaker.
Shake briskly with ice to aerate the pineapple juice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Mimosa
steps: Chill the orange juice, Prosecco and flute.
Pour the orange juice into the flute.
Add the Prosecco slowly, pausing if the foam rises.
Give the drink one gentle lift with a spoon if needed.
Finish with optional orange peel.

name: Mint Julep
steps: Place mint, sugar and water in the julep cup.
Press the mint gently until fragrant.
Measure in the bourbon.
Pack the cup with cracked ice.
Stir until the outside of the cup starts to frost.
Heap more cracked ice above the rim.
Nestle a mint sprig at the sipping edge.

name: Missionary’s Downfall
steps: Measure the rum, peach brandy, lime juice and honey syrup into a blender with pineapple chunks and mint leaves.
Blend with the measured crushed ice until smooth enough to pour.
Pour into a large coupe.
Finish with a mint sprig and a pineapple slice.

name: Mojito
steps: Lightly muddle the mint with lime juice and cane sugar in a highball.
Add a splash of soda to loosen any undissolved sugar.
Fill the glass with ice.
Pour in the white Cuban rum.
Top the glass with more soda.
Lift from the bottom with a bar spoon.
Tuck mint and a lime slice into the ice.

name: Monkey Gland
steps: Measure the dry gin, orange juice, absinthe and grenadine into a shaker.
Shake over ice until the mixture feels thoroughly chilled.
Fine-strain into a cold coupe.

name: Moscow Mule
steps: Fill a mule mug or rocks glass with ice.
Add the vodka, ginger beer and lime juice.
Give the drink one slow stir with a bar spoon.
Finish with a lime slice.
serving_notes: A rocks glass can also be used.

name: Naked and Famous
steps: Measure equal amounts of mezcal, Yellow Chartreuse, Aperol and lime juice into a shaker.
Shake sharply over ice until cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Negroni
steps: Fill a rocks glass with ice cubes.
Pour the gin, Campari and sweet vermouth over the ice.
Stir until the drink is cold and evenly mixed.
Slide a half-slice of orange alongside the cubes.

name: New York Sour
steps: Measure the rye or bourbon, syrup, lemon juice and egg white into a shaker.
Shake without ice to build foam.
Shake again with ice until cold.
Strain over fresh cubes in a rocks glass.
Float the wine across the back of a spoon.
Finish with citrus zest and a cherry if available.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

garnish: Lemon or orange zest and a cherry.

name: Old Cuban
steps: Chill a coupe and the sparkling wine.
Measure the mint, aged rum, lime juice, syrup and bitters into a shaker.
Shake with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into the coupe to catch any mint fragments.
Pour in the measured Champagne or Prosecco.
Finish with a mint sprig.

name: Old Fashioned
steps: Set a sugar cube in a rocks glass.
Wet it with bitters and a little water.
Muddle the cube until the sugar is mostly dissolved.
Add fresh ice.
Pour the bourbon or rye over the ice.
Stir until the whiskey is cold.
Finish with orange and a cocktail cherry.
garnish: Orange slice or zest, plus a cocktail cherry.

name: Paloma
steps: Pour lime juice, tequila and a pinch of salt into a highball.
Stir to dissolve the salt.
Fill the glass with ice.
Top with cold pink grapefruit soda.
Lift once with a spoon.
Finish with a lime slice.

name: Paper Plane
steps: Measure equal amounts of bourbon, Amaro Nonino, Aperol and lemon juice into a shaker.
Shake briskly with ice until cold.
Strain into a cold coupe.

name: Paradise
steps: Measure gin, apricot brandy and fresh orange juice into a shaker.
Shake hard over ice until the juice lightly froths.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Penicillin
steps: Muddle fresh ginger in the shaker.
Add blended Scotch, lemon juice and honey syrup.
Shake with ice until cold.
Fine-strain over fresh cubes to catch the ginger fibers.
Float Lagavulin gently on the surface.
Set a slice of candied ginger at the rim.

ingredients.note: Use 2–3 coin-sized slices of fresh ginger

name: Piña Colada
steps: Measure the white rum, coconut cream and pineapple juice into a blender.
Blend with enough ice to make a smooth, pourable frozen drink.
Pour into a hurricane glass.
Finish with a straw, pineapple and a cocktail cherry if available.
garnish: Pineapple slice and a cocktail cherry.

name: Pisco Punch
steps: Lightly crush the cloves in the simple syrup in a shaker.
Add the pisco, pineapple juice and lemon juice.
Shake firmly with ice.
Fine-strain into a goblet to remove the cloves.
Pour in the dry white wine.
Give the drink a gentle stir.

name: Pisco Sour
steps: Measure pisco, lemon juice, simple syrup and egg white into a shaker.
Shake without ice to build the foam.
Shake again with ice until cold.
Strain into a chilled goblet.
Dot the settled foam with Amargo bitters if available.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

garnish: Dash Amargo bitters over the foam.

name: Planters Punch
steps: Measure the Jamaican rum, lime juice and sugarcane juice into a small rocks glass or terracotta cup.
Stir to combine.
If you prefer a longer drink, dilute it a little at a time with water, ice or fresh juice.
Twist orange peel over the punch.
serving_notes: A small terracotta glass is another option.

name: Porn Star Martini
steps: Chill a coupe and the Champagne.
Measure the vanilla vodka, passion fruit liqueur, purée and vanilla sugar into a shaker.
Stir briefly to dissolve the sugar.
Shake firmly with ice.
Fine-strain into the coupe.
Finish with half a passion fruit and a little sugar if desired.
Pour the Champagne into a separate shot glass to serve alongside.
garnish: A passion fruit half with sugar.

name: Porto Flip
steps: Measure brandy, tawny port and egg yolk into a shaker.
Shake vigorously with ice until the yolk is fully incorporated.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
Grate a little nutmeg over the surface if available.

name: Rabo de Galo
steps: Set ice in a rocks glass.
Measure in the cachaça, Cinzano Rosso and Cynar.
Add the optional drops of bitters.
Give the drink a short stir.
Twist orange peel over the surface.

name: Ramos Fizz
steps: Measure the gin, both citrus juices, syrup, cream, egg white, orange blossom water and vanilla into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice for about two minutes.
Fine-strain the liquid back into the shaker, leaving the ice behind.
Shake without ice for another minute to build foam.
Pour into a highball.
Add cold soda slowly until the foam rises above the drink.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

name: Remember the Maine
steps: Roll the measured absinthe around the inside of a chilled coupe.
Tip out any absinthe left at the bottom of the glass.
Stir rye, sweet vermouth and the cherry liqueur with ice until cold.
Strain into the rinsed coupe.
Squeeze lemon peel over the surface.

name: Russian Spring Punch
steps: Fill a tall glass with fresh ice.
Shake the vodka, lemon juice, crème de cassis and syrup with separate ice.
Strain over the fresh ice in the glass.
Top with cold sparkling wine.
Finish with blackberries and an optional lemon slice.
garnish: Blackberries, with a lemon slice if desired.

name: Rusty Nail
steps: Fill a rocks glass with firm cubes.
Measure in the Scotch and Drambuie.
Stir slowly until the glass chills and the liqueur is evenly mixed.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over the drink.

name: Sazerac
steps: Swirl absinthe around a chilled rocks glass.
Add crushed ice to keep the glass cold while you mix the drink.
In a separate mixing glass, crush the sugar cube with Peychaud’s bitters.
Add the Cognac.
Stir with ice until the mixture is cold.
Tip out the crushed ice and excess absinthe from the rocks glass.
Strain into the empty, coated glass.
Express lemon oils over the surface.

name: Sea Breeze
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Add the vodka, cranberry juice and grapefruit juice.
Stir from the bottom until the color is even.
Finish with orange zest and a cocktail cherry if available.

name: Sex on the Beach
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Pour in vodka, peach schnapps, fresh orange juice and cranberry juice.
Give the mixture a short stir.
Rest a half-slice of orange against the ice.

name: Sherry Cobbler
steps: Cut the measured pieces of orange and lemon into quarters.
Put the quarters in a shaker with both sherries and the sugar.
Shake briskly with ice to release a little citrus juice.
Strain into a julep cup over crushed ice.
Finish with fresh berries, citrus and a straw.

ingredients.note: Half a wheel, cut into quarters
Half a wheel, cut into quarters

garnish: Fresh berries and a quarter-wheel each of orange and lemon. Serve with straws.

name: Sidecar
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure Cognac, triple sec and lemon juice into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice until the tin frosts.
Fine-strain into the chilled glass.

name: Singapore Sling
steps: Measure gin, cherry liqueur, Cointreau, Bénédictine, pineapple juice, lime juice, grenadine and bitters into a shaker.
Shake firmly with ice until the pineapple juice is lightly foamy.
Strain into a hurricane glass.
Add pineapple and a maraschino cherry if available.

name: South Side
steps: Measure the London dry gin, lemon juice, syrup and mint into a shaker.
Add the egg white if you want foam.
If you added egg white, shake hard without ice.
Shake with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe to catch flecks of mint.
Finish with a fresh mint sprig.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

name: Spicy Fifty
steps: Measure the thin chili slices, vanilla vodka, elderflower cordial, lime juice and honey syrup into a shaker.
Shake briskly with ice.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe to catch any seeds.
Rest a chili at the rim if desired.

name: Spritz
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add the cold Prosecco and Aperol.
Pour in a splash of soda.
Lift the mixture gently with a bar spoon.
Tuck an orange slice beside the ice.

name: Stinger
steps: Measure the Cognac and white crème de menthe into a mixing glass.
Stir with plenty of ice until very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Add a mint leaf if desired.

name: Suffering Bastard
steps: Measure Cognac or brandy, gin, lime juice and bitters into a shaker.
Shake with ice until cold.
Tip the entire contents into a Collins glass or the original mug.
Top with ginger beer.
Finish with mint and an optional orange slice.
garnish: Mint sprig and an optional orange slice.
serving_notes: The original Suffering Bastard mug can also be used.

name: Tequila Sunrise
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Pour the tequila and orange juice over the ice.
Trickle grenadine down the inside of the glass so it settles beneath the juice.
Finish with orange, leaving the layers intact.
garnish: Half an orange slice or orange zest.

name: Three Dots and a Dash
steps: Measure both rums, falernum, allspice dram, lime and orange juices, honey syrup and bitters into a blender.
Pulse with the measured crushed ice until the drink is cold and still loose enough to pour.
Pour into a footed copo glass.
Top up with more crushed ice.
Arrange three cherries and a piece of pineapple on top.

ingredients.note: 355 ml (12 US fl oz) of crushed ice, plus more for serving

garnish: Three cherries and a piece of pineapple.

name: Tipperary
steps: Measure Irish whiskey, sweet vermouth, Green Chartreuse and bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until cold and lightly diluted.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Add an orange slice.

name: Tommy’s Margarita
steps: Stir the agave nectar into the tequila and lime juice in a shaker.
Shake hard with ice until cold.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh cubes.
Tuck a lime slice beside the ice.

name: Trinidad Sour
steps: Measure the full pour of Angostura into a shaker with orgeat, lemon juice and rye.
Shake over ice until the tin feels cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Tuxedo
steps: Measure Old Tom gin, dry vermouth, maraschino, absinthe and orange bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Finish with lemon zest and a cocktail cherry if available.

name: Ve.N.To
steps: Measure the grappa, lemon juice, honey syrup and chamomile cordial into a shaker.
If using egg white, add it to the shaker.
If you added egg white, shake without ice to build foam.
Shake vigorously with ice until cold.
Strain over fresh cubes into a chilled rocks glass.
Finish with lemon zest and white grapes.

ingredients.note: Optionally use chamomile infusion for the water in the syrup

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

name: Vesper
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure the gin, vodka and Lillet Blanc into a shaker.
Shake hard with ice until very cold.
Strain into the coupe.
Squeeze lemon zest over the surface.

name: Vieux Carré
steps: Measure rye, Cognac, sweet vermouth, Bénédictine and Peychaud’s bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until the glass feels cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Finish with orange zest and a maraschino cherry.

name: Whiskey Sour
steps: Measure bourbon, lemon juice and syrup into a shaker.
Add egg white if you want foam.
If you added egg white, shake without ice first.
Shake with ice until cold.
Strain into a chilled cobbler glass, or over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
Finish with orange and a maraschino cherry if available.

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

garnish: Half an orange slice and a maraschino cherry, with optional orange zest.
serving_notes: For service over ice, use a rocks glass.

name: White Lady
steps: Chill a coupe.
Measure the gin, triple sec and lemon juice into a shaker.
Shake briskly with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into the coupe.

name: Zombie
steps: Make Donn’s Mix with two parts yellow grapefruit juice to one part cinnamon syrup.
Measure the mix, all three rums, lime juice, falernum, grenadine, bitters and Pernod into a blender.
Pulse for a few seconds with the measured cracked ice.
Pour into a tall glass.
Finish with mint leaves.

ingredients.note: Two parts yellow grapefruit juice to one part cinnamon syrup
